payload.register_cmd_template:
@echo off
REM Register ModelPolicy Reconciler — persistent Task Scheduler (mode A)
REM Generated by codex 01a11c30 (supervisor) — continuation envelope for T7 deploy step.
setlocal
set RECON_DIR=D:\AIOS\_agent-hub\policy\reconciler
set POLICY=D:\AIOS\_agent-hub\policy\model-policy.v1.yaml
set TASK=AIOS_ModelPolicy_Reconciler

REM Single-instance guard
wmic process where "name='python.exe' and commandline like '%%reconciler.py%%'" get ProcessId 2>nul | findstr /R "[0-9]" >nul
if not errorlevel 1 (
  echo [OK] Reconciler already running. Skipping.
  exit /b 0
)

REM Register schtask (5-min interval)
schtasks /Create /TN "%TASK%" /TR "python %RECON_DIR%\reconciler.py --policy %POLICY%" /SC MINUTE /MO 5 /F
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [WARN] schtasks register failed; falling back to on-demand.
  start "" python "%RECON_DIR%\reconciler.py" --policy "%POLICY%"
) else (
  echo [OK] Reconciler registered: %TASK% every 5 min.
)
endlocal
payload.title: Reconciler deploy: reconciler.py + register_reconciler.cmd
